name: Chitrakote Waterfall
description: India's broadest waterfall, a horseshoe-shaped cascade on the Indravati River often called the 'Niagara of India'. Spectacular during monsoon when it carries reddish, silt-laden water.
how_to_reach: About 40 km west of Jagdalpur via NH-30; taxis and buses available.
practical_notes: Best July-October for full flow; viewing platforms on both banks. Monsoon roads can be slippery. Boat rides offered in dry season.

name: Tirathgarh Waterfall
description: A multi-tiered waterfall cascading through the Kanger Valley, surrounded by dense forest and limestone formations.
how_to_reach: About 35 km from Jagdalpur inside Kanger Valley National Park.
practical_notes: Best post-monsoon. Combine with Kutumsar Caves. Park entry fee applies.

name: Kutumsar Caves
description: Limestone caves with stalactites and stalagmites, one of India's longest natural caves, home to blind fish.
how_to_reach: Inside Kanger Valley National Park, about 38 km from Jagdalpur.
practical_notes: Guided tours only; carry torch. Closed during monsoon flooding.

name: Danteshwari Temple
description: Ancient temple dedicated to Goddess Danteshwari, a revered Shakti Peetha and the royal deity of the Bastar kingdom.
how_to_reach: In Dantewada town, about 80 km south of Jagdalpur.
practical_notes: Major festival: Dussehra. Dress modestly. Photography restricted inside sanctum.

name: Bhoramdeo Temple
description: 11th-century Shiva temple famed for intricate carvings reminiscent of Khajuraho, set in forested hills.
how_to_reach: About 18 km from Kawardha; road access from Raipur (120 km).
practical_notes: Best October-March. Combine with Madwa Mahal nearby.

name: Dongargarh
description: Hilltop pilgrimage town with the Maa Bamleshwari Temple reached by ropeway, offering panoramic views.
how_to_reach: About 100 km from Raipur on NH-53; railhead at Dongargarh.
practical_notes: Ropeway operates daytime. Very crowded during Navratri.

name: Sirpur Laxman Temple
description: 7th-century brick temple, one of India's finest early Hindu temples, with exquisite carved doorframe.
how_to_reach: About 80 km east of Raipur via NH-53.
practical_notes: Combine with Gandheshwar Mahadev and Anand Prabhu Kuti Vihar. ASI site.

name: Mainpat Hill Station
description: Chhattisgarh's only hill station, known for Tibetan settlements, waterfalls and scenic meadows.
practical_notes: Best October-March. Roads can be foggy in winter.

name: Gangrel Dam
description: Large dam on the Mahanadi River with boating, picnic spots and scenic backwaters.
practical_notes: Boating available seasonally. Avoid during heavy monsoon release.

name: Barnawapara Wildlife Sanctuary
description: Dense forest sanctuary home to leopards, sloth bears, bison and rich birdlife.
practical_notes: Jeep safaris; book in advance. Best November-April.
address: Barnawapara, Baloda Bazar district, Baloda Bazar

name: Achanakmar Tiger Reserve
description: Tiger reserve in the Maikal hills with sal forests, tigers, leopards and gaur.
practical_notes: Safaris and forest rest houses; permits from forest department.

name: Kailash Caves
description: Natural limestone caves with stalactite formations, part of the Kanger Valley cave system.
practical_notes: Guided tours only; carry torch.

name: Maa Bamleshwari Temple
description: Hilltop temple dedicated to Goddess Bamleshwari, reached by ropeway, a major pilgrimage site.
how_to_reach: In Dongargarh, about 100 km from Raipur.
practical_notes: Very crowded during Navratri. Ropeway operates daytime.

name: Ratanpur Mahamaya Temple
description: Historic temple dedicated to Goddess Mahamaya, a major pilgrimage and architectural heritage site.
practical_notes: Best October-March. Temple complex with ancient structures.

name: Chaiturgarh Fort
description: Hilltop fort with temples and panoramic views, historically significant in the region.
practical_notes: Trekking required. Best in cooler months.

name: Sihawa Hills
description: Scenic hills and forested landscapes, considered the origin region of the Mahanadi River.
practical_notes: Best post-monsoon. Trekking and nature walks.

name: Giroudpuri Dham
description: Important pilgrimage site associated with Guru Ghasidas and the Satnami community.
practical_notes: Major festival gatherings. Basic facilities.

name: Vivekananda Sarovar
description: Urban lake with boating, gardens and a statue of Swami Vivekananda; popular evening hangout.
practical_notes: Open all day. Boating in evening.

name: Nandanvan Jungle Safari
description: Urban jungle safari with lion and tiger enclosures, boating and nature trails.
practical_notes: Book tickets online in peak season. Closed on certain days.

name: Ram Jharna
description: Scenic waterfall and picnic spot near Raigarh, popular with locals.
practical_notes: Best post-monsoon. Basic facilities.

name: Gomarda Wildlife Sanctuary
description: Forest sanctuary protecting diverse flora and fauna including leopards and deer.
practical_notes: Best November-April. Jeep safaris available.

name: Shivrinarayan Temple
description: Ancient temple at the confluence of rivers, an important pilgrimage site.
practical_notes: Best during festivals. Basic facilities.

name: Kudargarh Temple
description: Hilltop temple dedicated to Goddess Durga with panoramic views.
practical_notes: Trekking required. Best in cooler months.

name: Maitri Bagh Zoo
description: Zoo and park in Bhilai with animals, toy train and lake; family-friendly attraction.
practical_notes: Open daily. Toy train rides. Best October-March.

name: Tandula Dam
description: Dam and reservoir with scenic surroundings, popular for picnics and boating.
practical_notes: Best post-monsoon. Boating available seasonally.

name: Gadiya Mountain
description: Hill with historical fort ruins and panoramic views of the surrounding region.
practical_notes: Trekking required. Best in cooler months.

name: Keshkal Valley
description: Scenic valley with forested hills and tribal culture, a picturesque drive.
how_to_reach: On NH-30 between Kondagaon and Kanker.
practical_notes: Best October-March. Scenic drive.

name: Indravati National Park
description: National park protecting the endangered wild buffalo, with dense forests and riverine habitat.
practical_notes: Permits required. Best November-April. Remote location.

name: Guru Ghasidas National Park
description: National park in the Korea district with diverse wildlife and forest habitat.
practical_notes: Permits required. Best November-April.
